Primary_Symptoms: High fever; Myalgia; Fatigue
Secondary_Symptoms: Headache; Chills; Body ache; Anorexia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar kitne din se hai?; 2. Body me koi rash ya bleeding to nahi hai?; 3. Sardi ya khansi bhi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Paracetamol
Supportive_Medicines: ORS; Pantoprazole 40 mg OD
Precautions_Contraindications: Pregnancy safe; Caution in severe hepatic impairment or chronic alcoholism; Do not combine with other Paracetamol containing products
Home_Care_Advice: Adequate fluid intake; Sponge bath with room-temperature water; Rest
Lab_Investigations: CBC; Malarial Parasite test if fever persists beyond 3 days
Emergency_Red_Flags: High fever exceeding 103F not responding to antipyretics; Difficulty breathing; Excessive lethargy; Persistent vomiting

Primary_Symptoms: Fever; Severe body ache; Dry cough; Sore throat
Secondary_Symptoms: Headache; Nasal congestion; Fatigue; Chills
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi ke sath balgam aa raha hai?; 2. Saans lene me takleef hai?; 3. Bukhar ke sath thand lag rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Oseltamivir
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Steam inhalation; Hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Renal dose adjustment required in chronic kidney disease; Caution in bronchospasm
Home_Care_Advice: Isolation; Warm fluid intake; Rest; Hand hygiene
Lab_Investigations: Rapid Influenza Diagnostic Test; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Breathlessness; Chest pain; Cyanosis; Altered sensorium; Persistent high fever

Primary_Symptoms: High grade fever; Severe retro-orbital pain; Severe myalgia; Joint pain
Secondary_Symptoms: Skin rash; Nausea; Vomiting; Mild mucosal bleeding
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Aankho ke piche dard hai?; 2. Sharir par lal chakatte dekhe hain?; 3. Ulti ya pet me tez dard hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Paracetamol
Supportive_Medicines: ORS; Coconut water; Papaya leaf extract syrup
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use NSAIDs (Ibuprofen, Diclofenac, Aspirin) due to severe risk of bleeding; Caution in liver disease
Home_Care_Advice: Strict bed rest; Intensive oral hydration (ORS, fluids); Mosquito netting
Lab_Investigations: CBC with platelet count daily; Dengue NS1 Antigen; Dengue IgM/IgG
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Persistent vomiting; Severe abdominal pain; Bleeding from gums or nose; Black stool; Rapid platelet drop; Fluid accumulation

Primary_Symptoms: Step-ladder pattern fever; Abdominal pain; Coated tongue
Secondary_Symptoms: Headache; Anorexia; Constipation or diarrhea; Hepatosplenomegaly
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar dhere-dhere badh raha hai?; 2. Pet me dard ya kabz hai?; 3. Jiib par safed patti dikh rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Cefixime
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Probiotics; Hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Hypersensitivity to cephalosporins; Dose reduction in severe renal failure
Home_Care_Advice: Bland boiled diet; Hygienic drinking water; Avoid outside food; Bed rest
Lab_Investigations: Widal test; Blood culture; CBC; Typhidot
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe abdominal rigidity; GI bleeding; Black tarry stools; High fever with confusion; Shock

Primary_Symptoms: Fever with shivering/chills; Rigors; Profuse sweating
Secondary_Symptoms: Headache; Nausea; Vomiting; Fatigue; Splenomegaly
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar ek din chhodkar aa raha hai?; 2. Chills aur kapkapi hoti hai?; 3. Pasiina aane par bukhar kam hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Chloroquine
Dosage_Frequency: Initial 600 mg base then 300 mg at 6h, 24h, 48h
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Antiemetic (Ondansetron 4 mg)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Test for G6PD deficiency before starting Primaquine; Caution in psoriasis, retinal disease, and arrhythmia
Home_Care_Advice: Complete full course; Prevent mosquito bites; Adequate fluid intake; Rest
Lab_Investigations: Peripheral blood smear for MP; Malaria Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT); CBC; G6PD level
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Jaundice; Dark urine; Severe vomiting; Altered mental status; Severe anemia

Primary_Symptoms: Continuous or irregular high fever; Severe chills; Extreme prostration
Secondary_Symptoms: Profound jaundice; Confusion; Dark urine; Severe anemia; Vomiting
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar bina rukawat chal raha hai?; 2. Peshab ka rang kala ya gahra hai?; 3. Behoshi ya uljhan ho rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Artemether + Lumefantrine
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; IV fluids; Antiemetics
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 480 mg Artemether / 2880 mg Lumefantrine per course
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid in first trimester of pregnancy unless no alternative; Cardiac conduction disorders; QT prolongation
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate hospitalization usually required; Strict bed rest; High calorie liquid diet
Lab_Investigations: Peripheral blood smear; RDT for Pf; Liver Function Test; Renal Function Test; Urine hemoglobin
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Altered consciousness; Seizures; Black urine; Acute breathlessness; Severe jaundice; Oliguria

Primary_Symptoms: High fever; Severe incapacitating polyarthralgia; Joint swelling
Secondary_Symptoms: Maculopapular rash; Headache; Fatigue; Myalgia
Typical_Duration: Fever 3-7 days; Joint pain weeks to months
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Jodon me severe sujan aur dard hai?; 2. Mudne me takleef hoti hai?; 3. Sharir par rash aaya hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Paracetamol
Supportive_Medicines: Warm compress; Physiotherapy after acute phase; Oral hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Avoid Aspirin and non-selective NSAIDs in acute phase until Dengue is ruled out; Hepatic caution
Home_Care_Advice: Gentle movement; Rest; Hydration; Warm baths for joint stiffness
Lab_Investigations: Chikungunya IgM antibodies; RT-PCR; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Inability to bear weight; Severe swelling; Bleeding manifestations; Persistent high fever

Primary_Symptoms: Rhinorrhea; Nasal congestion; Sneezing
Secondary_Symptoms: Sore throat; Low-grade fever; Mild headache; Malaise
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Naak bah rahi hai ya band hai?; 2. Chinke aa rahi hain?; 3. Bukhar kitna hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Cetirizine + Paracetamol + Phenylephrine
Supportive_Medicines: Steam inhalation; Saline nasal drops; Warm water gargles
Precautions_Contraindications: Caution in hypertension, glaucoma, and prostatic hypertrophy due to Phenylephrine; Drowsiness with Cetirizine
Home_Care_Advice: Steam inhalation twice daily; Warm fluids; Proper hand washing; Rest
Lab_Investigations: None routinely required unless symptoms persist beyond 10 days
Emergency_Red_Flags: Difficulty breathing; High fever over 102F; Severe facial pain; Symptoms lasting >10 days without improvement

Primary_Symptoms: Severe odynophagia; Tonsillar enlargement with exudates; High fever
Secondary_Symptoms: Cervical lymphadenopathy; Earache; Altered voice; Halitosis
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khana nigalne me dard hota hai?; 2. Gale me safed daag/pus dikh raha hai?; 3. Bukhar hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Salt water gargles; Antacid
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; History of penicillin allergy or amoxicillin-associated hepatic dysfunction
Home_Care_Advice: Warm saline gargles 3-4 times daily; Soft bland diet; Avoid spicy/cold foods
Lab_Investigations: Throat swab culture; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Inability to swallow liquids; Trismus (inability to open mouth); Difficulty breathing; Stridor

Primary_Symptoms: Sore throat; Pain on swallowing; Scratchy sensation in throat
Secondary_Symptoms: Dry cough; Mild fever; Mild neck swelling; Rhinorrhea
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Gale me kharash hai ya tez dard?; 2. Khansi bhi hai?; 3. Bukhar hai kya?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Azithromycin
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 500 mg SOS; Dequalinium or Amylmetacresol lozenges
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Contraindicated in QT prolongation or myasthenia gravis; Caution in hepatic impairment
Home_Care_Advice: Salt water gargles; Warm tea/broth; Voice rest; Avoid smoke and irritants
Lab_Investigations: Throat swab test if bacterial origin suspected
Emergency_Red_Flags: Inability to swallow saliva or water; Breathing difficulty; High fever; Symptoms exceeding 7 days

Common_Names_Hindi: Sinus ki bimari; Sirdard aur naak band
Primary_Symptoms: Facial pain/pressure; Purulent nasal discharge; Nasal congestion
Secondary_Symptoms: Anosmia; Maxillary toothache; Cough; Headache
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chehre par jhukne par dard badhta hai?; 2. Naak se peela/hara muco-pus nikal raha hai?; 3. Danto me dard hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid
Supportive_Medicines: Steam inhalation; Xylometazoline 0.1% nasal spray (max 5 days); Paracetamol 650 mg
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Penicillin allergy; Avoid long-term topical decongestants to prevent rhinitis medicamentosa
Home_Care_Advice: Steam inhalation 3 times daily; Warm facial compress; High fluid intake
Lab_Investigations: X-ray PNS or CT PNS if recurrent or non-responsive
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Periorbital swelling or redness; Severe headache; Vision changes; High fever with neck stiffness

Common_Names_Hindi: Chet me khansi aur balgam; Bronchitis
Primary_Symptoms: Persistent cough (dry turning productive); Wheezing; Chest discomfort
Secondary_Symptoms: Low fever; Dyspnea on exertion; Fatigue; Sore throat
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi me balgam aa raha hai?; 2. Saan-saan ki aawaz aati hai?; 3. Kitne hafte se khansi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Levosalbutamol + Ipratropium syrup / inhaler
Popular_Indian_Brands: Duolin inhaler; Asthalin syrup; Macbery LS
Supportive_Medicines: Steam inhalation; Hydration; Paracetamol 500 mg for chest pain
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Caution in tachyarrhythmias, thyrotoxicosis, and uncontrolled hypertension
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid smoking and passive smoke exposure; Humidify living area; Warm fluids
Lab_Investigations: Chest X-ray if pneumonia suspected; Sputum examination
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Hemoptysis (blood in sputum); High fever; Severe shortness of breath; Symptoms lasting >3 weeks

Primary_Symptoms: High fever with chills; Productive cough with rusty/purulent sputum; Pleuritic chest pain
Secondary_Symptoms: Dyspnea; Tachypnea; Extreme fatigue; Confusion (in elderly)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi me hara ya lal balgam aata hai?; 2. Saans lene me chhati me dard hota hai?; 3. Saans phool rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Expectorant syrup; Oxygen therapy if hypoxemic
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Penicillin allergy; Severe renal failure (adjust dose); Caution in elderly
Home_Care_Advice: Strict bed rest; High calorie high protein diet; Hydration; Deep breathing exercises
Lab_Investigations: Chest X-ray PA view; CBC; Sputum culture & sensitivity; Pulse oximetry
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Oxygen saturation <92%; Cyanosis; Severe tachypnea (>30/min); Hypotension; Confusion

Primary_Symptoms: Dysuria; Urinary frequency; Urinary urgency; Lower abdominal discomfort
Secondary_Symptoms: Cloudy or foul-smelling urine; Hematuria; Low fever
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Peshab me jalan ya dard hai?; 2. Baar-baar peshab aane ka aabhas hota hai?; 3. Kamar ke piche ya peth me dard hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Nitrofurantoin
Supportive_Medicines: Disodium Hydrogen Citrate syrup (alkalinizer); Paracetamol 500 mg SOS
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Contraindicated in severe renal impairment (CrCl <60 mL/min), late term pregnancy, and G6PD deficiency
Home_Care_Advice: Drink 3-4 liters of water daily; Avoid delaying urination; Maintain perineal hygiene
Lab_Investigations: Urine Routine & Microscopy; Urine Culture & Sensitivity
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; High fever with rigors; Severe flank/back pain (pyelonephritis); Vomiting; Inability to void urine

Primary_Symptoms: Watery diarrhea; Repeated vomiting; Abdominal cramps
Secondary_Symptoms: Low fever; Dehydration; Weakness; Loss of appetite
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Ek din me kitni baar dast hua?; 2. Ulti ho rahi hai?; 3. Dast me khoon to nahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS)
Dosage_Frequency: Drink freely after each loose stool
Supportive_Medicines: Racecadotril 100 mg TDS; Ondansetron 4 mg SOS; Zinc 20 mg OD
Precautions_Contraindications: ORS is safe; Caution with anti-motility agents (Loperamide) in bloody diarrhea or high fever
Home_Care_Advice: Drink ORS, coconut water, rice kanji; Small frequent light meals (BRAT diet); Avoid milk and oily food
Lab_Investigations: Stool Routine & Microscopy; Serum Electrolytes if severe dehydration
Emergency_Red_Flags: Dehydration signs (sunken eyes, dry mouth, no urine >8h); Blood in stools; High fever; Inability to retain oral fluids

Primary_Symptoms: Frequent small-volume stools with blood and mucus; Severe abdominal cramps; Tenesmus
Secondary_Symptoms: Fever; Chills; Nausea; Dehydration
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Latrine me khoon ya aao (mucus) aa raha hai?; 2. Latrine ke baad bhi pet saaf lagta hai?; 3. Bukhar hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ciprofloxacin
Supportive_Medicines: ORS; Dicyclomine + Paracetamol for pain; Probiotics
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid in tendonitis history; Fluoroquinolone caution; Contraindicated in pregnancy
Home_Care_Advice: Maintain hydration with ORS; Light soft diet; Avoid raw fruits and outside water
Lab_Investigations: Stool Routine & Microscopy; Stool Culture
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; High grade fever; Massive bloody diarrhea; Signs of severe dehydration; Lethargy; Confusion

Primary_Symptoms: Abdominal cramps; Stools with mucus and dark blood; Tenesmus; Flatulence
Secondary_Symptoms: Low fever; Fatigue; Weight loss; Altered bowel habits
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pet me marod hokar latrine aati hai?; 2. Stool me chipchipa mucus dikhta hai?; 3. Bukhar kam rehta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Metronidazole
Supportive_Medicines: ORS; Probiotics (Saccharomyces boulardii); Antispasmodic
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Strict avoidance of alcohol during and 48h after therapy (disulfiram-like reaction); Caution in severe liver disease
Home_Care_Advice: Drink boiled water; Eat clean cooked food; Practice hand hygiene before eating
Lab_Investigations: Stool Routine & Microscopy (E. histolytica cysts/trophozoites)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe right upper quadrant abdominal pain (liver abscess); High fever; Persistent vomiting; Blood in stool

Primary_Symptoms: Hyperthermia (>104F in stroke); Profuse sweating (exhaustion) or dry hot skin (stroke); Dizziness
Secondary_Symptoms: Confusion; Headache; Nausea; Tachycardia; Syncope
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dhoop/garmi me kitne ghante rahe?; 2. Pasiina aana band ho gaya hai?; 3. Chakkar ya behoshi aayi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Oral Rehydration Therapy / IV Fluids (Normal Saline)
Supportive_Medicines: Cold saline infusion (in hospital); Paracetamol (NOT effective in heat stroke, use physical cooling)
Precautions_Contraindications: Avoid antipyretics like Aspirin/Paracetamol in pure heat stroke as they can aggravate hepatic injury; Immediate cooling is key
Home_Care_Advice: Move to cool/shaded place; Cold water sponging/ice packs on neck and axilla; Fan circulation; SIP ORS
Lab_Investigations: Serum Electrolytes; Renal Function Test; CPK; Liver Function Test
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Body temp >103F; Anhidrosis (no sweating); Confusion or loss of consciousness; Seizures; Low blood pressure

Primary_Symptoms: Jaundice (icterus); Dark yellow urine; Clay-colored stools; Severe fatigue
Secondary_Symptoms: Nausea; Vomiting; Right upper quadrant pain; Low fever; Anorexia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Aankhein ya peshab peela hua hai?; 2. Pet ke daahine taraf dard hai?; 3. Khana dekhkar ulti aati hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic supportive care (No specific antiviral)
Supportive_Medicines: B-complex vitamins; Antiemetic (Ondansetron 4 mg); Hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid all hepatotoxic drugs (Paracetamol >2g/day, NSAIDs, alcohol)
Home_Care_Advice: High carbohydrate low-fat diet; Complete physical rest; Avoid alcohol for 6 months; Strict hygiene
Lab_Investigations: Liver Function Test (Bilirubin, SGOT, SGPT, Alkaline Phosphatase); IgM anti-HAV
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Persistent intractable vomiting; Bleeding tendencies; Deepening jaundice with drowsiness/confusion (hepatic encephalopathy)

Primary_Symptoms: Yellow discoloration of sclera and skin; Dark brownish urine; Pale stools
Secondary_Symptoms: Pruritus; Fatigue; Abdominal pain; Anorexia; Fever (if cholangitis)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Peela rang kitne din se hai?; 2. Pet me tez dard hota hai?; 3. Bukhar aur kapkapi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic / Cause-specific treatment
Supportive_Medicines: Vitamin K supplements (if prolonged); Silymarin; Antiemetics
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid hepatotoxic medications; Dosage depends strictly on etiology
Home_Care_Advice: Rest; Low-fat diet; High fluid intake; Absolute abstinence from alcohol
Lab_Investigations: Total/Direct Bilirubin; SGOT/SGPT; Viral Markers (HBsAg, Anti-HCV); USG Abdomen
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; High fever with rigors and RUQ pain (Charcot triad); Encephalopathy signs; Gl bleeding; Severe lethargy

Common_Names_Hindi: Sharir me paani ki kami; Nirjalikaran
Primary_Symptoms: Thirst; Dry mouth; Oliguria; Sunken eyes; Loss of skin turgor
Secondary_Symptoms: Dizziness; Fatigue; Hypotension; Tachycardia; Confusion
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kitni baar peshab hua hai aaj?; 2. Gala aur muuh sookh raha hai?; 3. Dast ya ulti kitni baar hui?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS)
Dosage_Frequency: SIP continuously after every fluid loss
Supportive_Medicines: Zinc 20 mg OD; Probiotics; IV fluids (Normal Saline/Ringer Lactate if severe)
Precautions_Contraindications: Caution in cardiac failure or end-stage renal disease (fluid overload risk)
Home_Care_Advice: Drink ORS, coconut water, lemon water, buttermilk; Avoid caffeine and alcohol
Lab_Investigations: Serum Electrolytes (Sodium, Potassium); Blood Urea Nitrogen; Serum Creatinine
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Inability to drink fluids; Anuria (>12 hours no urine); Lethargy/Unresponsiveness; Low blood pressure; Cold extremities

Primary_Symptoms: Unilateral throbbing/pulsating headache; Photophobia; Phonophobia; Nausea
Secondary_Symptoms: Aura (visual flashes); Vomiting; Neck stiffness; Dizziness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dard sird ke ek taraf hota hai?; 2. Roshni ya aawaz se dard badhta hai?; 3. Dard se pehle aankho ke aage roshni chamakti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Naproxen OR Sumatriptan (acute attack)
Supportive_Medicines: Domperidone 10 mg (for nausea); Propranolol / Amitriptyline (for prophylaxis if frequent)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Sumatriptan contraindicated in ischemic heart disease, stroke, uncontrolled hypertension, and peripheral vascular disease
Home_Care_Advice: Rest in a dark quiet room; Cold compress on forehead; Avoid triggers (aged cheese, sleep deprivation, stress)
Lab_Investigations: Brain MRI/CT scan only if red flags present or atypical presentations
Emergency_Red_Flags: Thunderclap severe onset headache; Weakness/numbness on one side of body; Headache with fever and neck stiffness; Vision loss

Common_Names_Hindi: Tension ka sirdard; Maathe me dard
Primary_Symptoms: Bilateral band-like dull aching head pain; Pericranial muscle tenderness
Secondary_Symptoms: Neck stiffness; Mild fatigue; Mild anxiety
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sird par patti jaisa kadak pressure lagta hai?; 2. Dono taraf dard hai?; 3. Kaam karne se dard badhta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ibuprofen OR Paracetamol
Supportive_Medicines: Magnesium supplements; Muscle relaxants; Stress management
Precautions_Contraindications: Avoid prolonged continuous use to prevent medication-overuse headache; Gastric ulcer caution with Ibuprofen
Home_Care_Advice: Stress relaxation; Scalp massage; Warm compress on neck/forehead; Adequate sleep
Lab_Investigations: None usually required unless chronic
Emergency_Red_Flags: Sudden extreme severity headache; Neurological deficits; Onset after age 50; Progressive worsening over weeks

Common_Names_Hindi: Ek aankh ka tez sirdard; Cluster Sirdard
Primary_Symptoms: Severe strictly unilateral orbital/supraorbital pain; Ipsilateral lacrimation and nasal congestion
Secondary_Symptoms: Conjunctival injection; Ptosis; Miosis; Restlessness/agitation
Typical_Duration: 15 to 180 minutes per attack (occurs in clusters)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dard ek hi aankh ke piche hota hai?; 2. Usi taraf ki naak/aankh se paani aata hai?; 3. Patient dard se bechain hokar tahlne lagta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Sumatriptan (nasal spray / subcutaneous) + High-flow Oxygen
Supportive_Medicines: Verapamil 240-480 mg daily (prophylaxis under specialist guidance)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Ischemic heart disease, coronary vasospasm, uncontrolled hypertension
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid alcohol during cluster period; Maintain regular sleep schedule; Administer 100% Oxygen at 12 L/min via non-rebreather mask during attack
Lab_Investigations: Brain MRI with contrast to rule out structural lesions
Emergency_Red_Flags: New onset neurological deficit; Persistent pain between attacks; Horner's syndrome persisting after attack

Primary_Symptoms: Repetitive sneezing; Watery rhinorrhea; Itchy eyes/nose/palate; Nasal congestion
Secondary_Symptoms: Post-nasal drip; Dark eye circles (allergic shiners); Fatigue
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Ek sath 10-15 chinke aati hain?; 2. Naak aur aankho me khujli hoti hai?; 3. Mausam badalane par badhta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Levocetirizine
Supportive_Medicines: Fluticasone furoate nasal spray (2 puffs each nostril OD); Montelukast 10 mg
Precautions_Contraindications: Sedation risk; Caution in prostatic hyperplasia, severe renal failure (CrCl <10 mL/min)
Home_Care_Advice: Identify and avoid allergens (dust mites, pollen, pet dander); Use HEPA filters; Wash bedding in hot water
Lab_Investigations: Absolute Eosinophil Count (AEC); Skin Prick Testing; Serum IgE
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe breathlessness or wheezing; Secondary bacterial sinusitis; High fever

Primary_Symptoms: Acute ocular redness; Watery discharge; Foreign body sensation; Eyelid edema
Secondary_Symptoms: Photophobia; Preauricular lymphadenopathy; Morning crusting
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Aankh se paani ya chipchipa padarth nikal raha hai?; 2. Dono aankho me hai ya ek me?; 3. Subah aankhein chipak jati hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Carboxymethylcellulose 0.5% eye drops (lubricant)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Refresh Liquigel; Tear Drops; Refresh Tears
Supportive_Medicines: Cold compress; Moxifloxacin 0.5% eye drops (ONLY if secondary bacterial infection)
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use steroid eye drops without an ophthalmologist prescription (can cause glaucoma/blindness); Strict hand hygiene
Home_Care_Advice: Cold compresses over closed eyes; Wipe crusts with sterile wet cotton; Do not share towels/pillows; Avoid contact lenses
Lab_Investigations: Slit lamp examination if severe or non-responsive
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe eye pain; Marked decrease in vision; Severe corneal opacity; Photophobia

Primary_Symptoms: Centripetal vesicular rash (pleomorphic, dew-drops on rose petals); Moderate fever; Pruritus
Secondary_Symptoms: Malaise; Anorexia; Mild headache; Body ache
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sharir par paani waale fopoole (vesicles) bane hain?; 2. Naye aur purane dane ek sath hain?; 3. Khujli tez hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Acyclovir
Supportive_Medicines: Calamine lotion topically; Cetirizine 10 mg OD for itching; Paracetamol 650 mg SOS
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Adjust dose in renal impairment; Do NOT give Aspirin to children/adolescents (Reye's syndrome risk)
Home_Care_Advice: Isolate patient until all lesions crust over; Keep fingernails short; Soft cotton clothing; Cool baths with neem leaves
Lab_Investigations: Tzanck smear; Varicella IgM/IgG antibodies; Clinical diagnosis
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Hemorrhagic rash; Shortness of breath/cough (varicella pneumonia); Ataxia or altered consciousness; Secondary bacterial skin infection

Primary_Symptoms: High fever; 3 Cs: Cough, Coryza, Conjunctivitis; Maculopapular rash spreading face to body
Secondary_Symptoms: Koplik spots on buccal mucosa; Photophobia; Anorexia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar ke sath red rash chehre se shuru hokar niche phaila hai?; 2. Khansi, naak bahna aur aankh lal hai?; 3. Muuh ke andar safed daag hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic treatment + Vitamin A supplementation
Popular_Indian_Brands: Vitamin A capsules (as per WHO age dosing); Paracetamol
Adult_Strength_Mg: 200000 IU (Vitamin A for >1 year age on Day 1 and Day 2)
Dosage_Frequency: Single dose per day on Day 1 & Day 2
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 500 mg SOS; ORS; Calamine lotion
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Vitamin A teratogenic in high doses during pregnancy; Supportive therapy primary
Home_Care_Advice: Isolation; Bright room light avoidance if photophobic; High fluid intake; Maintain nutrition
Lab_Investigations: Measles IgM antibody; Throat swab RT-PCR
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Fast breathing or chest indrawing (pneumonia); Convulsions; Stridor; Severe diarrhea with dehydration; Ear discharge

Primary_Symptoms: Painful parotid gland swelling (unilateral or bilateral); Fever; Pain on chewing
Secondary_Symptoms: Otalgia; Trismus; Headache; Dry mouth
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaan ke niche gaal par sujan hai?; 2. Khatti chiz khane par dard badhta hai?; 3. Bukhar hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic supportive treatment (Paracetamol / Ibuprofen)
Supportive_Medicines: Warm or cold compress to parotid area; Soft bland diet; Hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Avoid acidic foods/juices that stimulate salivary secretion; Monitor for orchitis in post-pubertal males
Home_Care_Advice: Warm saline gargles; Soft diet requiring minimal chewing; Isolate for 9 days from onset of swelling
Lab_Investigations: Mumps IgM antibody; Serum Amylase
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe testicular pain and swelling (orchitis); Severe headache with neck stiffness (meningitis); Severe epigastric pain (pancreatitis)

Primary_Symptoms: Dermatomal painful vesicular eruption (strictly unilateral); Severe burning neuralgic pain
Secondary_Symptoms: Allodynia; Paresthesia; Fever; Regional lymphadenopathy
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dard ek hi taraf patti ki tarah phaila hai?; 2. Fopoole line me bane hain?; 3. Jalan aur chune par tez dard hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Acyclovir OR Valacyclovir
Supportive_Medicines: Pregabalin 75 mg BT (for neuropathic pain); Calamine lotion; Paracetamol 650 mg
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Initiate within 72 hours of rash onset for optimal efficacy; Renal dose adjustment required
Home_Care_Advice: Keep rash clean and dry; Avoid touching/scratching vesicles; Wear loose clothing; Isolate from non-immune pregnant women
Lab_Investigations: Tzanck smear; PCR for VZV
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Lesions on tip or side of nose/near eye (Herpes Zoster Ophthalmicus); Facial palsy; Secondary bacterial infection; Disseminated rash

Common_Names_Hindi: Kaan ka infection; Kaan me dard aur pus
Primary_Symptoms: Severe deep ear pain (otalgia); Fever; Hearing loss; Otorrhea (if perforation)
Secondary_Symptoms: Tinnitus; Irritability; Anorexia; Dizziness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaan me tez dard hai?; 2. Kaan se pus ya paani beh raha hai?; 3. Kam sunai de raha hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Otrivin nasal drops (to relieve eustachian tube congestion); Antacid
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Penicillin allergy; Do NOT put ear drops if tympanic membrane is perforated
Home_Care_Advice: Keep ear dry; Do not insert cotton swabs or objects into ear canal; Warm compress over external ear
Lab_Investigations: Otoscopic examination; Tympanometry
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Swelling, redness or tenderness behind the ear (mastoiditis); Facial muscle weakness; Vertigo; High fever with vomiting

Common_Names_Hindi: Kaan ke bahari hisse ka infection
Primary_Symptoms: Severe ear canal pain; Tragal tenderness; Pruritus in ear canal; Otic discharge
Secondary_Symptoms: Edema of ear canal; Conductive hearing loss; Erythema
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaan ki patti ko khichne par dard badhta hai?; 2. Paani jane ke baad dard shuru hua?; 3. Kaan me khujli hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone ear drops
Popular_Indian_Brands: Ciplox-D ear drops; Otiflox ear drops
Supportive_Medicines: Analgesics (Ibuprofen 400 mg TDS); Keep ear dry
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid aminoglycoside ear drops if tympanic membrane perforation suspected; Caution in diabetics (malignant otitis externa risk)
Home_Care_Advice: Keep ear dry during shower; Use earplugs while swimming; Do NOT scratch canal with keys or pins
Lab_Investigations: Otoscopy; Ear discharge swab for C/S if refractory
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe pain radiating to neck/head; Granulation tissue in ear canal; Severe pain in diabetic patient; Facial nerve palsy

Common_Names_Hindi: Muuh me safed chhaale; Oral Fungal Infection
Primary_Symptoms: White wipeable plaques on buccal mucosa and tongue; Erythematous base when scraped; Oral pain/burning
Secondary_Symptoms: Dysphagia; Loss of taste; Cheilitis; Dry mouth
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Muuh me safed patti jam gayi hai?; 2. Chhilne par khoon nikalta hai?; 3. Inhaler use karte hain ya diabetes hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Clotrimazole mouth paint / troches
Popular_Indian_Brands: Candid Mouth Paint; Nuforce Mouth Paint
Supportive_Medicines: Fluconazole 150 mg weekly (if severe); Good oral hygiene measures
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Caution in severe hepatic dysfunction (for systemic azoles); Rinse mouth after steroid inhalers
Home_Care_Advice: Rinse mouth thoroughly after steroid inhaler use; Maintain oral hygiene; Clean dentures daily; Avoid sugary foods
Lab_Investigations: Potassium Hydroxide (KOH) preparation of scrapings; Fasting Blood Sugar
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe pain on swallowing liquids/solids (esophageal candidiasis); Spread to throat; Unexplained weight loss

Primary_Symptoms: Painful round/oval superficial ulcers with erythematous halo on oral mucosa; Burning pain with spicy food
Secondary_Symptoms: Localized edema; Mild cervical lymphadenopathy; Anorexia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chhaale muuh ke andar gaal ya jeebh par hain?; 2. Teekha khane par tez lagta hai?; 3. Kitne din se hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Triamcinolone acetonide 0.1% oral paste
Popular_Indian_Brands: Kenacort Oral Paste; Tess Oral Paste
Supportive_Medicines: B-Complex with L-Lysine capsules; Choline salicylate + Lignocaine gel for topical anesthesia before meals
Precautions_Contraindications: Do not rub paste; apply gently; Caution if viral (herpetic) lesions suspected as steroids aggravate them
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid hot, spicy, acidic, and crunchy foods; Use soft toothbrush; Drink cold milk or water
Lab_Investigations: Complete Blood Count; Vitamin B12, Ferritin, Folate levels if recurrent
Emergency_Red_Flags: Ulcers non-healing >2 weeks (rule out oral malignancy); Severe pain preventing fluid intake; High fever; Multiple large >1 cm confluent ulcers

Common_Names_Hindi: Dant me mawaad; Dant ka dard
Primary_Symptoms: Severe throbbing toothache radiating to jaw/ear; Extreme sensitivity to hot/cold; Facial/gum swelling
Secondary_Symptoms: Foul taste; Fever; Cervical lymphadenopathy; Trismus
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dant me tez tis waala dard hota hai?; 2. Thanda ya garam lagta hai?; 3. Masure me sujan ya pus hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid
Supportive_Medicines: Ketorolac DT 10 mg SOS for severe pain; Chlorhexidine 0.2% mouthwash
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Antibiotics alone do NOT cure tooth abscess; Definitive dental treatment (RCT/Extraction) mandatory; Penicillin allergy
Home_Care_Advice: Rinse mouth with warm salt water; Do not apply heat outside cheek; Avoid chewing on affected side
Lab_Investigations: Dental Intraoral Periapical (IOPA) X-ray; Orthopantomogram (OPG)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Rapidly spreading facial or neck swelling (Ludwig's angina); Difficulty breathing or swallowing; High fever with rigors

Primary_Symptoms: Red, swollen, spongy gums; Bleeding gums during brushing or flossing
Secondary_Symptoms: Halitosis; Receding gums; Interdental papilla tenderness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Brush karte samay masooro se khoon aata hai?; 2. Masoore lal aur sooje hain?; 3. Muuh se badboo aati hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Chlorhexidine Gluconate 0.2% mouthwash
Supportive_Medicines: Vitamin C 500 mg OD; Metronidazole 400 mg TDS (ONLY if acute necrotizing ulcerative gingivitis)
Precautions_Contraindications: Long-term chlorhexidine use (>2 weeks) can cause reversible brown staining of teeth and altered taste sensation
Home_Care_Advice: Brush twice daily with soft bristles; Floss daily; Gentle gum massage; Schedule professional scaling
Lab_Investigations: Dental examination and periodontal probing
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Spontaneous profuse gum bleeding; Loose teeth; Severe ulceration of gums with high fever

Primary_Symptoms: High fever with severe rigors/chills; Flank/CVA tenderness; Dysuria; Vomiting
Secondary_Symptoms: Nausea; Hematuria; Costovertebral angle pain; Malaise
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar ke sath tez kapkapi aati hai?; 2. Pitth ke piche kamar ke upar tez dard hai?; 3. Peshab me jalan ya ulti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ceftriaxone (IV initial) then Cefixime OR Ciprofloxacin
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Antiemetic (Ondansetron 4 mg); High fluid intake
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Requires urgent parenteral therapy if patient cannot retain oral meds; Renal dose adjustment required
Home_Care_Advice: Drink at least 3 liters of water daily; Bed rest; Complete full antibiotic course strictly
Lab_Investigations: Urine Routine & Culture/Sensitivity; CBC; Serum Creatinine; USG KUB
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Persistent vomiting preventing oral intake; Anuria/Oliguria; Septic shock signs (hypotension, confusion); Persistent high fever despite 48h antibiotics

Common_Names_Hindi: Vitamin D ki kami; Haddi ka dard
Primary_Symptoms: Generalized bone pain; Muscle weakness; Fatigue; Frequent fractures
Secondary_Symptoms: Lower back pain; Muscle cramps; Mood changes; Impaired wound healing
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sharir aur haddiyo me hamesha meetha dard rehta hai?; 2. Dhoop me kitna samay bitate hain?; 3. Thakan jaldi hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3)
Supportive_Medicines: Calcium Carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 daily
Precautions_Contraindications: Hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, renal stones; Toxicity risk with extreme overdosage; Caution in sarcoidosis and hyperparathyroidism
Home_Care_Advice: Take supplement with milk or fatty meal for optimal absorption; Daily 20-minute morning sun exposure (10 AM - 2 PM)
Lab_Investigations: Serum 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D; Serum Calcium, Phosphorus, Alkaline Phosphatase
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Symptoms of hypercalcemia (severe nausea, confusion, polyuria, cardiac arrhythmia due to accidental overdose)

Common_Names_Hindi: Vitamin B12 ki kami; Naso ki kamzori
Primary_Symptoms: Symmetrical paresthesia (tingling/numbness in hands/feet); Fatigue; Megaloblastic anemia
Secondary_Symptoms: Glossitis (smooth red tongue); Ataxia; Memory loss; Irritability
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Haath-pairo me chiintiya katne jaisa lagta hai?; 2. Jeebh me lalapan aur jalan hai?; 3. Aap shuddh shakahari (vegetarian) hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Methylcobalamin
Supportive_Medicines: Folic Acid 5 mg OD; Multivitamins
Precautions_Contraindications: Generally non-toxic; Confirm diagnosis before treating to avoid masking B12 deficiency neurological damage while fixing folate anemia
Home_Care_Advice: Include fortified foods, dairy, eggs, milk in diet; Strict vegans require long-term supplementation
Lab_Investigations: Serum Vitamin B12; CBC with Peripheral Smear (MCV evaluation); Homocysteine
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe gait instability; Progressively worsening paralysis/weakness; Severe shortness of breath secondary to severe anemia

Primary_Symptoms: Profound fatigue; Exertional dyspnea; Pallor (conjunctiva, palms); Palpitations
Secondary_Symptoms: Pica (craving dirt/ice); Coilonychia (spoon nails); Angular stomatitis; Hair loss
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Jaldi thak jaate hain ya saans phoolti hai?; 2. Aankhein aur hatheli peeli/safed lagti hain?; 3. Mitti ya baraf khane ka man karta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ferrous Ascorbate + Folic Acid
Meal_Timing: Empty Stomach (or After Food if GI upset)
Supportive_Medicines: Vitamin C 500 mg (enhances iron absorption); Anthelmintic (Albendazole 400 mg single dose)
Precautions_Contraindications: Gastrointestinal irritation, constipation, dark black stools; Contraindicated in hemochromatosis, hemosiderosis, hemolytic anemia
Home_Care_Advice: Take with Vitamin C / citrus juice; Do NOT take with tea, coffee, milk, or antacids (inhibits absorption)
Lab_Investigations: CBC (Hemoglobin, RBC indices, MCV); Serum Ferritin; Total Iron Binding Capacity (TIBC)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Hemoglobin <6 g/dL; Severe angina/chest pain; Severe dyspnea at rest; Active heavy gastrointestinal or uterine bleeding

Primary_Symptoms: Excessive uncontrollable worry (>6 months); Restlessness; Muscle tension; Sleep disturbance
Secondary_Symptoms: Tachycardia; Sweating; Tremors; Fatigue; Irritability; Epigastric distress
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Har chhotii baat par behadh chinta hoti hai?; 2. Dil ki dhadkan tez hoti hai aur ghabraahat hoti hai?; 3. Sone me pareshani hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Escitalopram OR Sertraline
Supportive_Medicines: Clonazepam 0.25 mg SOS (short term max 2 weeks); Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Suicidal ideation risk in young adults during first weeks; Do not abruptly discontinue (withdrawal syndrome); Serotonin syndrome risk
Home_Care_Advice: Practice deep breathing exercises (Pranayama); Limit caffeine and alcohol intake; Regular exercise; CBT
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Function Test (FT3, FT4, TSH); ECG; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Active suicidal thoughts or self-harm intent; Severe panic attacks with chest pain; Acute psychosis

Primary_Symptoms: Difficulty falling asleep or maintaining sleep; Non-restorative sleep; Daytime fatigue
Secondary_Symptoms: Irritability; Poor concentration; Impaired daytime function; Headache
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Raat ko neend aane me kitna samay lagta hai?; 2. Raat me baar-baar neend toot-ti hai?; 3. Din me thakan aur chidchidapan rehta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Zolpidem OR Melatonin
Supportive_Medicines: Sleep hygiene therapy; Chamomile tea; Relaxation techniques
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; High abuse/dependence potential for Zolpidem; Avoid driving or operating machinery; Contraindicated in obstructive sleep apnea
Home_Care_Advice: Strict sleep hygiene: fixed bedtime, dark quiet cool room, no screen time 1 hour before sleep, avoid caffeine after 4 PM
Lab_Investigations: Polysomnography (sleep study) if chronic and refractory
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe depression symptoms; Hallucinations or sleepwalking incidents; Severe daytime somnolence causing accidents

Primary_Symptoms: Nausea and vomiting during travel; Dizziness; Cold sweats; Pallor
Secondary_Symptoms: Headache; Excessive salivation; Fatigue; Apathy
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Gaadi, bus ya jahaz me baithne par ulti aati hai?; 2. Chakkar aur ghabraahat hoti hai?; 3. Safar se pehle dawai li hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Cinnarizine OR Avomine (Promethazine teoclate)
Supportive_Medicines: Domperidone 10 mg SOS; Ginger lozenges
Precautions_Contraindications: Sedation and somnolence; Caution in epilepsy, Parkinsonism, glaucoma, prostatic hypertrophy
Home_Care_Advice: Sit in front seat or over wing; Look at distant fixed horizon; Avoid reading/screens during travel; Ensure good ventilation
Lab_Investigations: None required
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe unremitting vomiting causing prostration and dehydration; Persistent vertigo hours after travel stops

Primary_Symptoms: Throbbing headache at high altitude (>2500m); Nausea; Fatigue; Dizziness
Secondary_Symptoms: Anorexia; Insomnia; Shortness of breath on exertion; Peripheral edema
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kitni unchai par gaye hain?; 2. Sird me tez dard aur ulti hai?; 3. Saans phool rahi hai ya chalne me ladkhadahat hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Acetazolamide
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS for headache; Antiemetics; Oxygen inhalation
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Contraindicated in Sulfa drug allergy, severe renal/hepatic impairment, hyperchloremic acidosis
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate descent is definitive treatment if symptoms worsen; Gradual ascent max 300-500m/day above 3000m; Avoid alcohol and sedatives; High hydration
Lab_Investigations: Pulse Oximetry; Arterial Blood Gas if severe
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; High Altitude Pulmonary Edema (cough with pink frothy sputum, severe dyspnea); High Altitude Cerebral Edema (ataxia, confusion, coma)

Primary_Symptoms: Triad: High fever, Exudative pharyngitis, Severe cervical lymphadenopathy
Secondary_Symptoms: Splenomegaly; Fatigue (lasting weeks); Palatal petechiae; Maculopapular rash
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Gale me dard aur sujan ke sath tez bukhar hai?; 2. Patal/neck me badi ganth ban gayi hai?; 3. Bahut zyada thakan rehti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic supportive treatment (Paracetamol / Ibuprofen)
Supportive_Medicines: Warm saline gargles; Hydration; Corticosteroids (Prednisone) strictly if airway compromised
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT prescribe Amoxicillin or Ampicillin (causes severe non-allergic maculopapular rash in 90% of cases); Splenic rupture risk
Home_Care_Advice: Strict avoidance of contact sports and heavy lifting for at least 3-4 weeks (to prevent splenic rupture); Adequate rest
Lab_Investigations: Paul-Bunnell test / Monospot test; EBV Serology; CBC (Atypical lymphocytes >10%); Liver Function Test
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Acute stridor or breathing difficulty due to tonsillar hypertrophy; Sudden severe left upper quadrant abdominal pain (splenic rupture); Jaundice

Primary_Symptoms: Profuse painless 'rice-water' watery stools; Rapid severe dehydration; Projectile vomiting
Secondary_Symptoms: Muscle cramps; Hypovolemic shock; Anuria; Loss of skin turgor
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Latrine chawal ke paani jaisi bilkul patli ho rahi hai?; 2. Bina marod ke baar-baar dast ho raha hai?; 3. Pyas bahut zyada lag rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) + Doxycycline (or Azithromycin)
Supportive_Medicines: Zinc 20 mg OD; IV Ringer Lactate (aggressive rehydration)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 300 mg Doxycycline single dose or 200 mg/day
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Doxycycline contraindicated in pregnancy and children <8 years (use Azithromycin 1g single dose instead)
Home_Care_Advice: Drink ORS liberally after every stool; Maintain strict sanitary disposal of feces; Hand hygiene with soap
Lab_Investigations: Stool Hanging Drop examination for Vibrio cholerae motility; Stool Culture; Serum Electrolytes
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe hypovolemic shock (unmeasurable BP, feeble pulse); Anuria; Lethargy; Severe muscle cramps

Common_Names_Hindi: Scrub Typhus; Keede ke katne ka bukhar
Primary_Symptoms: High fever with chills; Eschar (black necrotic punch-out lesion); Severe headache; Lymphadenopathy
Secondary_Symptoms: Myalgia; Maculopapular rash; Hepatosplenomegaly; Dry cough
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sharir par kahi koyle jaisa mita hua kala daag (eschar) hai?; 2. Bukhar ke sath tez sirdard aur badan dard hai?; 3. Khet ya jhaadiyo me gaye the?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Doxycycline
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Antacid; IV fluids
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Contraindicated in pregnancy (use Azithromycin 500 mg OD) and young children; Pill esophagitis risk (take with full glass of water)
Home_Care_Advice: Take medication sitting upright with plenty of water; Clear brush/grass around dwelling; Use insect repellents
Lab_Investigations: Scrub Typhus IgM ELISA; Weil-Felix test; CBC; Liver Function Test
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS); Altered mental status/encephalitis; Renal failure; Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation

Primary_Symptoms: High fever with chills; Severe calf/lumbar muscle tenderness; Conjunctival suffusion (redness without pus)
Secondary_Symptoms: Jaundice; Oliguria; Hemorrhagic manifestations; Hepatomegaly
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Pindaliyo (calves) me tez dard hai?; 2. Aankhein bina keechad ke lal hain?; 3. Baadh ke paani ya choohe ke peshab se sampark hua hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Doxycycline OR Amoxicillin
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; IV fluids; Dialysis supportive care if renal failure
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid Doxycycline in pregnancy (use Penicillin/Amoxicillin); Dosing adjustment in acute kidney injury
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid walking barefoot in floodwaters or waterlogged soil; Rodent control; Cover skin cuts with waterproof dressing
Lab_Investigations: IgM Leptospira ELISA; MAT (Microscopic Agglutination Test); Serum Creatinine; LFT
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Weil syndrome (Jaundice + Renal Failure + Bleeding); Hemoptysis (pulmonary hemorrhage); Anuria; Shock

Primary_Symptoms: Fever; Dry cough; Anosmia (loss of smell); Ageusia (loss of taste); Fatigue
Secondary_Symptoms: Sore throat; Myalgia; Nasal congestion; Diarrhea
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Swaad aur mehak aana band ho gayi hai?; 2. Khansi aur bukhar hai?; 3. Oxygen saturation (SpO2) kitna hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Paracetamol
Supportive_Medicines: Ivermectin / Paxlovid (if high risk, per local protocols); Vitamin C 500 mg OD; Zinc 50 mg OD; Warm saline gargles
Precautions_Contraindications: Monitor SpO2 using pulse oximeter 6 hourly; Avoid self-administering systemic steroids in early mild phase (increases viral replication)
Home_Care_Advice: Home isolation for 7 days; Proning position to improve oxygenation; Hydration; Continuous pulse oximetry monitoring
Lab_Investigations: Rapid Antigen Test (RAT); RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2; CBC, CRP, D-Dimer if worsening
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; SpO2 dropping <94% on room air; Persistent high fever >3 days; Severe tightness or pain in chest; Confusion

Common_Names_Hindi: Post-viral Kamzori; Bukhar ke baad ki thakan
Primary_Symptoms: Profound physical fatigue; Post-exertional malaise; Muscle weakness
Secondary_Symptoms: Brain fog; Sleep disturbance; Mild arthralgia; Mood swings
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bukhar theek hone ke baad bhi kamzori lag rahi hai?; 2. Thoda sa kaam karne par fatigue badhta hai?; 3. Dhyan lagane me pareshani hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Multivitamins with Coenzyme Q10 / Zinc / B-Complex
Supportive_Medicines: Oral Rehydration Solutions; Balanced nutrition; Gentle graded exercise
Precautions_Contraindications: Exclude ongoing active chronic infection, thyroid disease, or clinical depression before treating as simple post-viral asthenia
Home_Care_Advice: Graded pacing of daily activities; Avoid overexertion; Ensure 8 hours of sleep; Nutritious diet rich in protein
Lab_Investigations: CBC; TSH; Serum Ferritin; Blood Sugar; Vitamin D3 & B12
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; New neurological deficits; Unexplained severe weight loss; Recurrent high fever; Severe depression with self-harm ideation

Primary_Symptoms: Wheezing; Dyspnea; Shortness of breath; Cough
Secondary_Symptoms: Chest tightness; Prolonged expiration; Tachypnea; Nocturnal cough
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Saan-saan ki aawaz aati hai?; 2. Raat me ya mausam badalne par saans phoolti hai?; 3. Inhaler lene par aaram milta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Salbutamol + Ipratropium inhaler OR Budesonide inhaler
Popular_Indian_Brands: Asthalin Inhaler; Foracort Inhaler; Duolin Inhaler
Adult_Strength_Mg: 100 mcg Salbutamol / 200 mcg Budesonide per puff
Supportive_Medicines: Montelukast 10 mg OD; Steam inhalation
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Inhalers and oral/inhaled steroids are Rx and must be started by a doctor; Caution in tachyarrhythmias and severe CAD
Home_Care_Advice: Rinse mouth with water after steroid inhaler use; Avoid triggers (dust, cold air, smoke, pets); Use spacer
Lab_Investigations: Spirometry with bronchodilator reversibility; Peak Expiratory Flow Rate (PEFR); CBC (Eosinophils)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe breathlessness with inability to speak full sentences; Cyanosis; Silent chest; SpO2 <92%

Common_Names_Hindi: Purana Dama; Smoker ki Saans ki Bimari
Primary_Symptoms: Progressive dyspnea; Chronic cough; Productive sputum
Secondary_Symptoms: Wheezing; Fatigue; Anorexia; Exertional dyspnea
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Saans phoolna dhere-dhere badh raha hai?; 2. Aap Bidi ya Cigarette peete hain?; 3. Subah khansi ke sath balgam aata hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Tiotropium inhaler OR Formoterol + Budesonide inhaler
Popular_Indian_Brands: Tiova Inhaler; Foracort 200 Inhaler; Seroflo Inhaler
Supportive_Medicines: Mucolytic (Acebrophylline 100 mg BD); Short-acting bronchodilator SOS
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Inhalers and steroids are Rx and must be started by a doctor; Caution in narrow-angle glaucoma and BPH with Tiotropium
Home_Care_Advice: Strict smoking cessation; Annual influenza and pneumococcal vaccination; Pulmonary rehabilitation exercises
Lab_Investigations: Spirometry (Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC <0.70); Chest X-ray PA view; Arterial Blood Gas (ABG)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Acute severe dyspnea; Cyanosis; Drowsiness/Confusion; Peripheral edema; Purulent sputum surge

Primary_Symptoms: Paroxysmal dry cough; Wheezing; Chest tightness
Secondary_Symptoms: Nasal congestion; Throat itchiness; Exertional dyspnea
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi bina balgam ke aati hai?; 2. Dhool ya dhuye se khansi badhti hai?; 3. Gale me khujli lagti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Levocetirizine + Montelukast
Supportive_Medicines: Budesonide inhaler 200 mcg BD (if severe); Steam inhalation
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Neuropsychiatric event warning with Montelukast; Sedation caution
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid environmental triggers; Use N95 mask in dusty areas; Keep living space dust-free; Warm fluids
Lab_Investigations: Absolute Eosinophil Count (AEC); Total IgE levels; Spirometry
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe breathlessness; High fever with purulent sputum; Hemoptysis

Primary_Symptoms: Hoarseness of voice (Dysphonia); Aphonia; Dry tickling cough
Secondary_Symptoms: Throat pain; Dysphagia; Low fever; Frequent throat clearing
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Aawaz bilkul baith gayi hai?; 2. Gale me kharash ya meetha dard hai?; 3. Zor se bolne ke baad hua hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic treatment + Steam inhalation
Supportive_Medicines: Warm saline gargles; Dequalinium throat lozenges
Precautions_Contraindications: Do not strain voice; Avoid irritants; Antibiotics NOT indicated for routine viral laryngitis
Home_Care_Advice: Complete voice rest (avoid whispering or shouting); Steam inhalation 3 times daily; Warm fluid intake; Avoid alcohol/caffeine
Lab_Investigations: Indirect laryngoscopy if hoarseness lasts >2 weeks
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Stridor; Difficulty breathing; Inability to swallow fluids; Hoarseness persisting beyond 2 weeks

Primary_Symptoms: Nasal obstruction; Mucopurulent rhinorrhea; Facial pressure/fullness; Reduced sense of smell
Secondary_Symptoms: Post-nasal drip; Halitosis; Chronic cough; Maxillary dental pain
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Naak hamesha band rehti hai?; 2. Piche gale me balgam girta hai?; 3. Maathe ya chehre par bhari-pan rehta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Fluticasone furoate nasal spray OR Mometasone nasal spray
Popular_Indian_Brands: Furomist Nasal Spray; Metaspray Nasal Spray
Supportive_Medicines: Nasal saline irrigation (Neti pot); Amoxicillin-Clavulanate if bacterial flare up
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid spraying directly onto nasal septum to prevent epistaxis/ulceration
Home_Care_Advice: Nasal saline douching twice daily; Warm compress over face; Avoid smoke and pollutants
Lab_Investigations: CT scan PNS (Paranasal Sinuses); Nasal endoscopy; Allergy skin testing
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Orbital swelling or vision changes; Severe unilateral headache; Meningeal signs; High fever with facial erythema

Common_Names_Hindi: Kaan me dabba lagna; Kaan band hona
Primary_Symptoms: Ear fullness/popping sensation; Muffled hearing; Autophony (hearing own voice)
Secondary_Symptoms: Ear pain; Tinnitus; Mild imbalance; Crackling sound on swallowing
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaan me gubbara jaisa bhari-pan lagta hai?; 2. Zukam ke baad kaan band hua hai?; 3. Nigalne par tik-tik ki aawaz aati hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Xylometazoline 0.1% nasal spray + Levocetirizine
Dosage_Frequency: 2 drops each nostril BD / 1 tab OD
Supportive_Medicines: Steam inhalation; Valsalva maneuver guidance
Precautions_Contraindications: Do NOT use Xylometazoline for >5 days to avoid rebound congestion (rhinitis medicamentosa); Caution in hypertension
Home_Care_Advice: Valsalva maneuver (gentle popping of ear); Chew sugar-free gum; Steam inhalation
Lab_Investigations: Tympanometry; Audiometry; Nasopharyngoscopy
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe otalgia; Otorrhea (discharge from ear); Sudden sensorineural hearing loss; Severe vertigo

Common_Names_Hindi: Kaan me aawaz aana; Seeti bajna
Primary_Symptoms: Subjective ringing, buzzing, or hissing sound in ears; Hearing impairment
Secondary_Symptoms: Sleep disturbance; Anxiety; Irritability; Difficulty concentrating
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaan me seeti ya buzzing ki aawaz aati hai?; 2. Ye aawaz dono kaan me hai ya ek me?; 3. Kam sunai deta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ginkgo Biloba extract OR Betahistine (if vascular/Meniere's)
Supportive_Medicines: Vitamin B12 supplements; Zinc; Sound therapy / Masking devices
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Caution with Ginkgo in bleeding disorders or patients on anticoagulants
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid loud noise exposure; Use white noise machines for sleep; Limit salt, caffeine, and nicotine intake
Lab_Investigations: Pure Tone Audiometry (PTA); MRI Brain/CP Angle if unilateral tinnitus
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Pulsatile tinnitus synchronized with heartbeat; Unilateral sudden hearing loss; Associated weakness/numbness of face

Primary_Symptoms: Episodic rotational vertigo triggered by head position changes; Nystagmus
Secondary_Symptoms: Nausea; Vomiting; Unsteadiness; Lightheadedness
Typical_Duration: Seconds to minutes per episode (weeks duration)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khada hone ya karwat lene par kamra ghoomta lagta hai?; 2. Chakkar kuch second rehta hai?; 3. Ulti jaisa lagta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Betahistine
Supportive_Medicines: Cinnarizine 25 mg SOS; Epley Maneuver (repositioning procedure)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Betahistine contraindicated in pheochromocytoma; Caution in peptic ulcer and bronchial asthma
Home_Care_Advice: Perform positional repositioning exercises under guidance; Avoid sudden head movements; Rise slowly from bed
Lab_Investigations: Dix-Hallpike Test; Electronystagmography (ENG); MRI Brain if atypical
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Vertigo accompanied by limb weakness, dysarthria, diplopia, or ataxia (stroke signs); Sudden hearing loss

Common_Names_Hindi: Meniere's disease; Kaan ki wajah se chakkar
Primary_Symptoms: Triad: Episodic vertigo (hours), Fluctuating sensorineural hearing loss, Low-frequency Tinnitus; Aural fullness
Secondary_Symptoms: Nausea; Vomiting; Horizontal nystagmus; Gait instability
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chakkar ghanto tak rehta hai?; 2. Kaan me ghan-ghan ki aawaz aur bhari-pan hota hai?; 3. Chakkar ke sath sunai kam deta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Betahistine + Hydrochlorothiazide (diuretic maintenance)
Supportive_Medicines: Cinnarizine 25 mg SOS during acute attack; Antiemetics (Ondansetron 4 mg)
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Electrolyte imbalance caution with diuretics; Caution in asthma and peptic ulcer
Home_Care_Advice: Strict low-sodium diet (<1.5g/day); Avoid caffeine, alcohol, nicotine, and monosodium glutamate (MSG); Hydrate evenly
Lab_Investigations: Pure Tone Audiometry (fluctuating low-frequency SNHL); Electrocochleography; MRI CP angle
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Prolonged intractable vertigo lasting >24 hours; Sudden drop attacks (Tumarkin crisis); Severe dehydration from vomiting

Primary_Symptoms: Severe unilateral throat pain; Trismus (inability to open mouth); Hot potato voice; Uvular deviation
Secondary_Symptoms: High fever; Dysphagia; Drooling of saliva; Ipsilateral earache
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Ek taraf gale me tez dard hai?; 2. Muuh poora nahi khul raha hai?; 3. Thook nigalne me severe dard hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid (IV/Oral) OR Clindamycin
Supportive_Medicines: Needle aspiration or Incision & Drainage; Paracetamol 650 mg; IV hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Immediate specialist ENT evaluation required for surgical drainage; Penicillin allergy caution
Home_Care_Advice: Maintain hydration with soft/liquid diet; Warm saline gargles; Ice collars on neck
Lab_Investigations: CBC; Soft tissue neck X-ray/CT scan; Pus culture & sensitivity
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Airway compromise; Inability to swallow saliva; Severe trismus; Spreading neck swelling or stiffness

Common_Names_Hindi: Phephde ki patti me dard; Pleurisy
Primary_Symptoms: Sharp stabbing localized chest pain aggravated by inspiration/coughing; Shallow breathing
Secondary_Symptoms: Fever; Dyspnea; Dry cough; Pleural friction rub
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Saans andar lene ya khansne par chhati me tez sui jaisa dard hota hai?; 2. Saans rokne par dard kam hota hai?; 3. Bukhar hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ibuprofen OR Indomethacin
Supportive_Medicines: Pantoprazole 40 mg OD (gastric protection); Paracetamol 650 mg
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid NSAIDs in active peptic ulcer, severe renal impairment, and bleeding disorders
Home_Care_Advice: Lie on the affected side to reduce chest wall movement; Deep breathing as tolerated; Rest
Lab_Investigations: Chest X-ray PA view (rule out effusion/pneumonia); Ultrasound thorax; CBC; ESR; ECG
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Acute breathlessness; High fever; Hemoptysis; Hypotension; Pleural effusion accumulation

Common_Names_Hindi: Chhati ki haddi me dard; Costochondritis
Primary_Symptoms: Localized anterior chest wall pain reproduciable on palpation; Sharp aching sternal pain
Secondary_Symptoms: Pain on deep inspiration; Pain exacerbated by arm movement or coughing
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chhati ki haddi ko dabane par tez dard hota hai?; 2. Haath hilane ya jhukne par dard badhta hai?; 3. ECG/Heart Report normal hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Naproxen OR Diclofenac
Supportive_Medicines: Pantoprazole 40 mg OD; Topical NSAID gel (Volini/Voveran gel)
Precautions_Contraindications: Gastric mucosal irritation; Avoid in chronic renal failure or active peptic ulcer disease; Rule out cardiac etiology first
Home_Care_Advice: Warm or cold compress over sternum; Avoid strenuous upper body exercise or heavy lifting; Gentle stretching
Lab_Investigations: ECG (to rule out ischemic heart disease); Chest X-ray PA view
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Pain radiating to left arm/jaw with diaphoresis (rule out MI); Shortness of breath; Syncope

Primary_Symptoms: Rapid shallow tachypnea; Carpopedal spasm (hand cramps); Circumoral paresthesia; Dizziness
Secondary_Symptoms: Chest tightness; Palpitations; Lightheadedness; Anxiety
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Ghabraahat me bahut tez saans chalne lagti hai?; 2. Haath-pairo me sunn-pan ya chiintiya kat ti hain?; 3. Ungliyan mudne lagti hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Reassurance + Anxiolytic (Clonazepam / Lorazepam short-term)
Supportive_Medicines: Rebreathing into a paper bag (under supervision); Grounding relaxation exercises
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid over-sedation; Rule out organic causes of hypoxia before attributing to hyperventilation
Home_Care_Advice: Practice slow abdominal diaphragmatic breathing (4-7-8 technique); Reassurance; Limit stressors and caffeine
Lab_Investigations: Pulse Oximetry (SpO2 usually 99-100%); Arterial Blood Gas (respiratory alkalosis); ECG
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Oxygen saturation <95%; Chest pain radiating to arm/jaw; Cyanosis; Loss of consciousness

Common_Names_Hindi: Phephdo ki nali ka phailna; Bronchiectasis
Primary_Symptoms: Chronic cough with copious purulent foul-smelling sputum; Recurrent hemoptysis; Dyspnea
Secondary_Symptoms: Wheezing; Fatigue; Weight loss; Digital clubbing; Halitosis
Typical_Duration: Chronic lifelong condition with acute exacerbations
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Subah uthte hi bahut zyad balgam nikalta hai?; 2. Balgam me khoon aata hai?; 3. Baar-baar chhati me infection hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid OR Ciprofloxacin (for exacerbation)
Supportive_Medicines: Chest physiotherapy & postural drainage; Inhaled hypertonic saline 3%; Acebrophylline
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Adjust antibiotic according to sputum culture; Quinoline tendonitis risk
Home_Care_Advice: Daily postural drainage and airway clearance techniques; Active cycle of breathing techniques; Annual vaccinations
Lab_Investigations: High-Resolution CT (HRCT) Thorax; Sputum Culture & Sensitivity; Sputum for AFB
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Massive hemoptysis (>100 mL blood in 24h); High grade fever; Severe hypoxia; Acute respiratory failure

Primary_Symptoms: Progressive dry cough; Progressive exertional dyspnea; Fine bibasilar velcro crepitations
Secondary_Symptoms: Fatigue; Weight loss; Digital clubbing; Cyanosis
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dhere-dhere saans phoolna badh raha hai?; 2. Sukhi khansi mahino se hai?; 3. Pairo ki ungliya aage se moti (clubbing) hui hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Pirfenidone OR Nintedanib (anti-fibrotic maintenance under specialist care)
Supportive_Medicines: Steroids (Prednisolone under doctor care); Supplemental Oxygen therapy; N-Acetylcysteine 600 mg TDS
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Inhalers, immunosuppressants, and steroids are Rx and must be started by a doctor; Liver enzyme monitoring required
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid exposure to organic/inorganic dusts; Continuous supplemental oxygen if hypoxemic; Pulmonary rehabilitation
Lab_Investigations: HRCT Thorax (UIP/NSIP pattern); Pulmonary Function Test (Restricted pattern, reduced DLCO); Autoimmune panel
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Acute exacerbation with rapidly worsening dyspnea; SpO2 dropping <88%; Fever; Right heart failure signs

Common_Names_Hindi: Karkhane ki dhool se allergy; Dust Allergy
Primary_Symptoms: Rhinitis; Wheezing; Dry cough on exposure to dust; Eye irritation
Secondary_Symptoms: Dyspnea on exertion; Throat itching; Skin rashes; Fatigue
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaam ke sthan par jaate hi khansi/chinke aati hain?; 2. Chhutti ke din symptoms kam hote hain?; 3. Kis cheez ki factory/workplace me kaam karte hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Levocetirizine + Montelukast
Supportive_Medicines: Fluticasone nasal spray; Salbutamol inhaler SOS for bronchospasm
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Drowsiness with antihistamines; Montelukast mood change precautions
Home_Care_Advice: Wear N95/FFP3 respirators at workplace; Improve industrial ventilation; Change clothes after work
Lab_Investigations: Spirometry; Total IgE; Chest X-ray PA view
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe acute asthma attack; Hemoptysis; Progressive shortness of breath at rest

Common_Names_Hindi: Kisaan ki saans ki bimari; Moldy Hay Allergy
Primary_Symptoms: Acute onset fever, chills, dry cough, and dyspnea 4-8h after exposure to moldy hay/crops
Secondary_Symptoms: Malaise; Anorexia; Fine bibasilar rales; Weight loss (chronic form)
Typical_Duration: Acute episodes 24-48 hours; Chronic form persistent
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khet me soookha chara/gehu sambhalne ke baad bukhar-khansi hui hai?; 2. Chhati me saans phoolti hai?; 3. Kaam se dur rehne par aaram milta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Prednisolone (oral steroid under specialist guidance)
Supportive_Medicines: Salbutamol inhaler SOS; Supplemental Oxygen if hypoxemic
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Steroids are Rx and must be prescribed by a physician; Avoid abrupt withdrawal; Monitor blood glucose
Home_Care_Advice: Strict avoidance of exposure to moldy agricultural products; Ensure crops are dried before storage; Wear respirators
Lab_Investigations: HRCT Thorax; Precipitating antibodies (precipitins) against Thermophilic Actinomycetes; PFT
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe hypoxemia (SpO2 <90%); Persistent high fever; Severe exertional dyspnea

Common_Names_Hindi: Aawaz ki nali me ganth; Singer's Nodules
Primary_Symptoms: Persistent hoarseness of voice; Vocal fatigue; Loss of vocal range; Breathy voice
Secondary_Symptoms: Frequent throat clearing; Throat soreness; Pitch breaks
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Zyada bolne ya gaane ke baad aawaz baith jati hai?; 2. Aawaz me phatapan mahino se hai?; 3. Kya aap teacher/singer/speaker hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Symptomatic / Proton Pump Inhibitor (if LPR co-exists)
Supportive_Medicines: Steam inhalation; Voice therapy under Speech Pathologist
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid indiscriminate antibiotic or steroid use; Mainstay is speech therapy, not drugs
Home_Care_Advice: Strict absolute voice rest initially; Speech therapy for vocal hygiene; Hydrate well (8-10 glasses water); Avoid shouting
Lab_Investigations: 70-degree Rigid / Flexible Video Laryngoscopy; Stroboscopy
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Rapidly progressive dysphonia; Stridores; Hemoptysis; Unilateral neck mass

Common_Names_Hindi: Adenoids ki sujan; Gale ke piche ki ganth
Primary_Symptoms: Nasal obstruction; Mouth breathing; Snoring; Hyponasal speech (rhinolalia clausa)
Secondary_Symptoms: Persistent purulent rhinorrhea; Recurrent otitis media; Sleep apnea; Daytime somnolence
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bachha/Adult muuh kholkar saans leta hai?; 2. Raat me dhar-dhar ki aawaz (snoring) aati hai?; 3. Kaan me baar-baar infection hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid
Supportive_Medicines: Mometasone nasal spray 1 puff each nostril OD; Saline nasal spray
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Penicillin allergy caution; Prolonged nasal congestion needs specialist ENT review
Home_Care_Advice: Nasal saline douching; Elevated head during sleep; Maintain hydration
Lab_Investigations: X-ray Nasopharynx lateral view; Diagnostic Nasal Endoscopy
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Obstructive sleep apnea with respiratory pauses; Severe difficulty swallowing; Recurrent high fever with purulent discharge

Primary_Symptoms: Profuse watery rhinorrhea; Nasal congestion triggered by temp change, spicy food, stress
Secondary_Symptoms: Post-nasal drip; Sneezing; Facial pressure; Absence of nasal itching/Eosinophilia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Thand, teekha khana ya tezz mahak se naak bahne lagti hai?; 2. Naak ya aankho me khujli NAI hoti?; 3. Mausam badalne par congestion hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ipratropium bromide nasal spray OR Azelastine nasal spray
Supportive_Medicines: Saline nasal douching; Montelukast 10 mg
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Ipratropium caution in narrow-angle glaucoma and prostatic hypertrophy
Home_Care_Advice: Avoid identified non-allergic triggers (spicy food, abrupt temp changes, perfume); Saline nasal rinses
Lab_Investigations: Nasal Endoscopy; Skin Prick Test (negative for allergens); Absolute Eosinophil Count (normal)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Unilateral clear watery nasal discharge (rule out CSF rhinorrhea); Epistaxis; Secondary bacterial infection

Primary_Symptoms: Sensation of fluid dripping into back of throat; Constant throat clearing; Chronic dry cough
Secondary_Symptoms: Sore throat; Hoarseness; Halitosis; Feeling of lump in throat (globus)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Gale ke piche balgam tapakta hua mehsoos hota hai?; 2. Baar-baar khakharne (throat clear) ki aadat hai?; 3. Khansi raat ko ziada hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Fluticasone furoate nasal spray + Levocetirizine
Dosage_Frequency: 2 puffs OD each nostril / 1 tab OD
Supportive_Medicines: Warm saline gargles; Saline nasal douching; Antacid if GERD related
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Avoid overuse of sedating antihistamines; Proper spray technique
Home_Care_Advice: Saline nasal irrigation twice daily; Keep hydrated; Elevate head end of bed; Avoid late night heavy meals
Lab_Investigations: CT PNS; Diagnostic Nasal Endoscopy; Allergy testing
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Hemoptysis; Unilateral nasal obstruction; Dysphagia; Unexplained weight loss

Primary_Symptoms: Loud habitual snoring; Observed nocturnal apnea/gasping; Excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS)
Secondary_Symptoms: Morning headache; Unrefreshing sleep; Impaired concentration; Nocturia; Irritability
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Raat ko kharraate aate hain aur saans achanak rukti hai?; 2. Din me baith-baith kar neend aati hai?; 3. Subah uthte hi sirdard rehta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: CPAP (Continuous Positive Airway Pressure) therapy - No primary drug
Supportive_Medicines: Modafinil 100 mg OD (only for residual daytime sleepiness under specialist guidance); Weight loss therapy
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Sedatives, alcohol, and hypnotics are strictly CONTRAINDICATED as they worsen airway collapse
Home_Care_Advice: Weight reduction; Side-sleeping position (positional therapy); Avoid alcohol and sedatives before bedtime; CPAP compliance
Lab_Investigations: Polysomnography (Overnight Sleep Study - AHI index); Drug-Induced Sleep Endoscopy (DISE)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Severe daytime somnolence causing motor vehicle accidents; Severe morning hypertension; Arrhythmias; Uncontrolled right heart failure

Common_Names_Hindi: Saans ki nali ka infection; Tracheitis
Primary_Symptoms: Deep barking brassy cough; High fever; Inspiratory stridor; Retractions
Secondary_Symptoms: Purulent tracheal secretions; Dyspnea; Hoarseness; Severe throat/chest pain
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi kutte ki aawaz (barking cough) jaisi hai?; 2. Saans andar lene me seeti (stridor) bajti hai?; 3. Tez bukhar hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid OR Ceftriaxone
Supportive_Medicines: Humidified Oxygen; Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Nebulized L-Epinephrine under hospital care
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Potentially life-threatening airway emergency; Hospital admission often required
Home_Care_Advice: Keep patient calm; Cool mist humidification; High fluid intake; Avoid supine position if stridor present
Lab_Investigations: Neck X-ray (AP/Lateral - steeple sign); Tracheal secretion culture; CBC; Pulse Oximetry
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Respiratory distress; Inspiratory stridor at rest; Cyanosis; Severe lethargy; Inability to clear thick secretions

Primary_Symptoms: Severe progressive exertional dyspnea; Barrel chest; Pursed-lip breathing; Weight loss
Secondary_Symptoms: Chronic mild dry cough; Wheezing; Prolonged expiration; Fatigue
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Saans phoolna itna zyada hai ki thoda chalne par bhi lagta hai?; 2. Chhati dhol jaisi (barrel chest) ho gayi hai?; 3. Saans muuh gol karke (pursed lip) chhode hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Tiotropium bromide inhaler OR Indacaterol + Glycopyrronium
Supportive_Medicines: Acebrophylline 100 mg BD; Home Long-Term Oxygen Therapy (LTOT) if hypoxemic
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Inhalers and steroids are Rx and must be started by a doctor; Caution in urinary retention and glaucoma
Home_Care_Advice: Smoking cessation mandatory; Pursed-lip breathing exercises; High-calorie nutritional supplements; Avoid air pollution
Lab_Investigations: HRCT Thorax (Centrilobular/Panlobular emphysema); PFT (DLCO significantly reduced); ABG; Alpha-1 Antitrypsin level
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Acute exacerbation with severe hypoxemia; SpO2 <88%; Confusion; New onset peripheral edema

Primary_Symptoms: Persistent dry tickling cough (>8 weeks duration); Throat irritation
Secondary_Symptoms: Absence of sputum; Sleep disturbance; Chest muscle soreness; Headache
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi bina balgam ke mahino se hai?; 2. BP ki dawai (ACE inhibitors) khaate hain?; 3. Raat me ya khana khane ke baad badhti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Dextromethorphan + Chlorpheniramine syrup
Adult_Strength_Mg: 10 mg Dextromethorphan / 2 mg CPM per 5 mL
Supportive_Medicines: Levocloperastine syrup; Treat underlying cause (GERD/Asthma/ACEi adjustment)
Precautions_Contraindications: Avoid in asthma with thick secretions; Caution with driving due to CPM sedation; Review BP drugs (enalapril/ramipril cause dry cough)
Home_Care_Advice: Sip warm water frequently; Honey and ginger tea; Use steam inhalation; Avoid smoke exposure
Lab_Investigations: Chest X-ray PA view; Spirometry; Esophageal pH monitoring if GERD suspected
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Hemoptysis; Unexplained weight loss; Persistent fever; Night sweats; Progressive breathlessness

Primary_Symptoms: Persistent cough with purulent/mucoid sputum (>8 weeks); Chest congestion
Secondary_Symptoms: Wheezing; Dyspnea; Rhonchi on auscultation; Early morning sputum surge
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi me roz balgam aata hai?; 2. Balgam ka rang peela/hara hai?; 3. Bidi/Cigarette peete hain ya asthma hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Ambroxol + Terbutaline + Guaiphenesin syrup
Adult_Strength_Mg: 30 mg Ambroxol / 1.25 mg Terbutaline / 50 mg Guaiphenesin per 5 mL
Supportive_Medicines: Acebrophylline 100 mg BD; Steam inhalation; Hydration
Precautions_Contraindications: Caution in cardiac tachyarrhythmias, hypertension, hyperthyroidism due to Terbutaline; Gastric irritation with mucolytics
Home_Care_Advice: Drink plenty of warm fluids (thins mucus); Postural chest clapping; Smoking cessation
Lab_Investigations: Chest X-ray PA view; Sputum for AFB / Culture & Sensitivity; GeneXpert for TB
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Blood in sputum (hemoptysis); High fever; Severe breathlessness; Weight loss and night sweats

Primary_Symptoms: Paroxysmal violent coughing fits followed by high-pitched inspiratory 'whoop'; Post-tussive vomiting
Secondary_Symptoms: Subconjunctival hemorrhages; Facial petechiae; Apnea (in infants); Cyanosis
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Khansi ke daure padte hain aur aakhir me 'hoop' ki aawaz aati hai?; 2. Khansne ke baad ulti hoti hai?; 3. Danto/aankho me lalapan aaya hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Azithromycin OR Erythromycin
Supportive_Medicines: Paracetamol SOS; Cough suppressants contraindicated; Saline nebulization
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Erythromycin/Azithromycin caution in cardiac arrhythmia and hepatic dysfunction; Isolate patient
Home_Care_Advice: Isolate for 5 days post-antibiotic initiation; Small frequent meals to prevent post-tussive emesis; Keep patient calm
Lab_Investigations: Nasopharyngeal swab PCR for Bordetella pertussis; Culture; Marked Lymphocytosis on CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Needs in-person doctor evaluation; Apneic spells; Cyanosis during coughing fits; Seizures; Pneumonia signs; Severe dehydration

Common_Names_Hindi: Naak me maas badhna; Nasal Polyps
Primary_Symptoms: Bilateral nasal obstruction; Anosmia/Hyposmia; Watery or mucoid nasal discharge
